_title: How late is the last train in Europe? · glosx.app
_desc: Last direct train of the day between the main cities of Switzerland, Austria, Sweden, Finland, Norway and Spain, from official open timetables (GTFS).
b0: How late is the last train?
b1: The last direct train of the day between the main cities of six European countries, calculated by glosx.app from the official open timetables of each rail operator (weekday, autumn 2026).
b9: Last direct train on a weekday
b41: Times are local departure times. A departure after midnight counts as the same evening. On a few long routes the last direct train is a night train.
b43: Source: the official GTFS timetables published by SBB (opentransportdata.swiss), ÖBB, Trafiklab / Samtrafiken, Digitraffic / Fintraffic, Entur and Renfe.
b44: Only direct trains count; coupled trains running at the same times count once.
b45: Reference days: one weekday, one Saturday and one Sunday of the autumn 2026 timetable.
b46: Timetables change: check the operator before you travel.
b47: Download all the data (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0)
b50: WoW Train (glosx.app), “How late is the last train? Main city pairs in 6 European countries”, https://glosx.app/last-train-europe/. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23827431.
